notes: NEW GRAPHICS (BETA): BLOOM & COLOUR. Lamps, neon signs, fire, muzzle flashes, wonder weapons and the sun now glow. Night maps glow more, day maps stay clean.
Film colour grading on every map: richer colour, cool shadows and warm highlights, a soft vignette. Dark rooms stay as easy to see as before.
Smoother edges: FXAA when MSAA is off, and a light sharpen on HIGH so the picture stays crisp at lower render scales.
Settings > VIDEO > EFFECTS: BLOOM & COLOUR (OFF / LOW / HIGH) and GLOW (0-200%). The presets pick it for you (LOW preset = OFF, MEDIUM = LOW, HIGH and ULTRA = HIGH). PERFORMANCE MODE turns it off.
Still in from 1.2.62, 1.2.61 and 1.2.60: THE MARY JANE (zombies chapter five), DISPENSARY ROW, SMOKE OUT, RE-UP, PUFF PUFF PASS, Season 2 HARVEST, save codes, block, word filter, error reports.
